entries.title: Work that asks for something done no longer stops at a quick answer
entries.body: When a task asks for something to be done, such as a review published, a change merged or a merge card shown, and it starts as a quick answer, it now hands the work back to your first mate, which starts it right away as real work. Before, it showed a card saying what it had read, with Look deeper as the only way on. Such work starts twice, the second time on a stronger model, so it uses a little more of your plan's allowance.
entries.noPicture: This change is in what crewmates, the first mate and the part of the app that sorts new work are told, so no view changes.
